name: flin-bigquery-mcp
description: Explore BigQuery datasets and run read-only SQL with per-query byte limits.
long_description: Connect Google BigQuery to Claude Desktop on macOS. Browse projects, datasets, schemas and table previews. SELECT queries are checked with a dry run and a configurable byte ceiling before submission; they can incur Google Cloud charges. Requires a Desktop OAuth client and BigQuery permissions. Tokens are stored locally. No table write tools are exposed.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Client ID from your Google Cloud OAuth client of type Desktop app.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Client secret belonging to the same Desktop app OAuth client.

default_project.title: Default BigQuery project
default_project.description: Google Cloud project used for discovery and query billing. Can also be supplied per tool call.

location.title: BigQuery location
location.description: Must match your dataset, for example EU, US or europe-west6. Leave blank for automatic location selection.

max_bytes_billed.title: Maximum bytes billed per query
max_bytes_billed.description: Positive integer. Default 1073741824 (1 GiB). Each tool call can lower this ceiling but cannot raise it.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check local configuration and saved sign-in status.

tools.name: get_table
tools.description: Inspect nested schema, partitioning and clustering.

tools.name: preview_table
tools.description: Preview a bounded page from a physical table.

tools.name: dry_run_query
tools.description: Validate a SELECT and estimate scanned bytes.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Submit a bounded SELECT query; may incur Google charges.

tools.name: get_query_results
tools.description: Poll a job and retrieve one page of results.
